text_nodes.raw_text: The elder Gaius To the beloved whom I love in [the] truth
Beloved in every way I pray that you may prosper and enjoy good health as prospers your soul {also}
I was overjoyed For . . . came [when the] brothers and testified about your devotion to the truth . . . you in [which] continue to walk
greater than no I have joy to hear [that] my children in the truth are walking
Beloved faithful you are in what . . . you are doing for the brothers and [especially since] they are strangers [to you]
[They] have testified about your love to [the] church . . . well You will do to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God
on behalf For of the Name they went out nothing accepting from the Gentiles
we Therefore ought to support such [men] so that fellow workers we may be for the truth
I have written [about this] to the church but who loves to be first . . . Diotrephes will not accept our [instruction]

So . . . if I come I will call attention to [his] . . . malicious slander [against] us And unsatisfied with that he refuses to welcome the brothers and those who want to do so forbids even out of the church putting [them]
Beloved {do} not imitate what [is] evil but what [is] good The [one who] does good of God is the [one who] does evil has not seen God
Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone and from itself the truth We also testify [for him] and you know that testimony our true is
many things I have to write to you but not I would prefer with ink and pen . . . [to do so]
I hope Instead soon you to see and [face] to [face] speak [with you] Peace to you send you greetings . . . The friends [ here ] Greet [each of our] friends [there] by name
